summary: Implemented the rich_measure feature without running any code or tests, and nothing is committed. Changes: (1) rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__, which walks expanded nodes and returns the widest label plus a 4-cell guide indent per depth, clamped to max_width (added Measurement import). (2) rich/align.py: added VerticalCenter(renderable, style=None), which pads blank lines above and below to options.height (extra line goes to bottom), plus __rich_measure__ delegating to the wrapped renderable. (3) tests/test_tree.py: added test_tree_measure with hand-computed expectations; tests/test_align.py: added test_vertical_center. (4) CHANGELOG.md: added an Unreleased entry. Unverified: tests have not been run, black was not run, CONTRIBUTORS.md was not updated. Choices to review: Tree measurement definition (collapsed subtrees excluded), and VerticalCenter being created new since it did not exist in the repo.
